S64PAIR.scope: FP16 single row D64; actual X/R and gamma/bias positive aligned gap <=uint16 DMA block stride; otherwise COMBO fallback
S64PAIR.mechanism: Replace X/R and gamma/bias DMA pairs by two-block strided DMA; arithmetic and readiness ordering unchanged; pass fewer GM pointers

S256PAIR.scope: S256B one-row/core FP32 guard; actual X/R and gamma/bias positive gap <=uint32 byte stride; otherwise S256B fallback
S256PAIR.mechanism: Replace X/R and gamma/bias DMA pairs by two-block strided DMA; arithmetic and readiness ordering unchanged; pass fewer GM pointers

address_policy: Use actual pointer differences with bounded nonnegative strides. Never assume allocator order, contiguous allocation or values; incompatible layouts use original entry.
